outcome: Time interval to achieve target oxygen saturation (SpO2 >=90%)
Time interval to achieve 95% oxygen saturation
cohort: The study included 204 healthy newborns, selected from 553 infants born at Charoenkrung Pracharak Hospital.
finding: The median time to achieve 90% oxygen saturation was 6.5 minutes (range 2-10 minutes) and 7 minutes (range 2-10 minutes) for 95% saturation, with mode of delivery being the only factor significantly influencing oxygen saturation adaptation time.
mod_finding: Infants born by cesarean delivery took significantly longer to reach a stable SpO2 >=90% than infants born by vaginal delivery.
